Behind every cookie

From Our Kitchen to Your Heart

Zelaya Sweets began with faith, a love of baking, and a simple goal: to bring a little sweetness into people's lives.

Every cookie is handmade in small batches, from the familiar comfort of chocolate chip to colorful flavors like ube and Neapolitan.

Thank you for being part of our story.

Good to know

Cookie Box Details

Please read our ordering and payment policies before sending a request.

🚚

Pickup & Delivery

Free local delivery within 5 miles of East Los Angeles. Pickup available by arrangement. Delivery beyond 5 miles will be quoted before payment.

📅

Order Notice

Premium cookies require at least 72 hours’ notice; regular cookies generally require 24 hours’ notice. All requested dates must be confirmed.

💳

Payment First

Once we confirm your order and total, payment is due in full through Cash App before preparation begins. Do not send payment before confirmation.

↺

Rescheduling

Rescheduling requests are welcome with sufficient advance notice and are subject to availability.

☑

Cancellations

Full refund if canceled before preparation begins. After preparation starts, refunds are subject to our policy and applicable law.

✦

Ingredients & Allergens

Ingredient and allergen details are being finalized. Please contact us about allergens before submitting an order request.

Zelaya Sweets is working through registration and product requirements. Please contact us to confirm whether a requested product can be legally fulfilled.
